name: removal_waits_on_its_card
title: A removal in a conversation ends its turn on the card, and the answer resumes it

steps.reply:
Your food log is set up, under a new **Food** section.

**How to use it:** tell me what you ate in plain words, like "two eggs and toast for breakfast" or "had a flat white at 3". I'll add one entry per item with the time, the meal, the amount, and calories, protein, carbs and fat. If you don't give the nutrition numbers, I'll estimate them from a typical portion and mark them as estimates. If you don't give a time, I'll use the time you tell me.

There's also a **Calories per day** chart that fills in as you log.

steps.routed_by: judge: 'Track what I eat' is ongoing, standing work (a food log kept current) rather than something finished in one turn, and no open item covers it.

steps.reply:
